payload.core_mechanism_summary: Checks if any of the first min(n,40) elements is divisible by LCM of 2..i+2 (where i is 0-indexed). If so, impossible due to number-theoretic greedy condition; else possible.
payload.rationale: The solution is a feasibility check based on a necessary and sufficient condition, derived via greedy/constructive reasoning (exchange argument). No heap, pointers, or sorting used.
